chunks: "Whoever takes hold of the four sides of the bier, Allah will forgive forty major sins for him."

key_terms.السَّرِيرِ: the bier or funeral bier carried for the deceased
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِجَوَانِبِ: by the sides of; holding the sides of the bier

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for carrying the funeral bier from all four sides in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام speaks of the great reward for participating in carrying the funeral bier. It highlights the spiritual merit of serving in funeral rites and the forgiveness Allah grants for this act.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.454 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever takes hold of the four sides of the bier (funeral bier) will have forty major sins forgiven by Allah (swt)."
